notes.title: Mars Odyssey Patch now with Oculus Touch Support
notes.content:
Whats New 

Oculus Touch Support
Updated Graphics
Performance Optimizations
Explore Mode - After completing the story mode, you can enter transpod and revist the landers without having to accomplish the tasks.
